review the BaseImageGenTest abstract class and its required get_base_image_generation_call_args method
refactor the TestCustomLogger class to capture additional logging fields from the standard logging payload
run the bedrock image generation unit tests for stability nova canvas and titan models
test the BedrockImageGeneration handler to build request bodies for stability and nova canvas models
test the AmazonStability3Config transform_request_body method to convert prompts and params into bedrock request dicts
test the AmazonNovaCanvasConfig transform_request_body method to handle text image and color guided generation tasks
test the cost_calculator function to compute pricing for bedrock image generation models by size and steps
test the fal_ai image generation endpoint constructs correct URL headers and request body
run async image generation using litellm aimage_generation with a fal_ai model and prompt
test the fal_ai authorization header uses the Key prefix format with the API key
test the fal_ai endpoint URL includes fal.run and the expected model path
mock the fal_ai HTTP post call to return a fake image generation response for testing
test image editing with litellm image_edit using gpt-image-1 model and multiple reference images
test azure image editing with litellm aimage_edit using azure/gpt-image-1 model and mocked HTTP requests
test image edit cost tracking with a custom logger that captures standard logging payload and response cost
test image editing via litellm Router with aimage_edit for gpt-image-1 model and multiple images
test RecraftImageEditConfig parameter mapping and request transformation for recraftv3 model with supported OpenAI params
test image generation using litellm with vertex_ai/imagen-3.0-fast-generate-001 model and Vertex AI credentials
test bedrock amazon.nova-canvas-v1 image generation with text-to-image task type and configurable cfg scale
test that dynamic api_key parameter is used for AIML provider authentication instead of environment variables
test azure gpt-image-1 request body matches expected JSON payload by mocking the HTTP handler
load Vertex AI service account credentials from env vars and write them to a temp JSON file
test async xinference image generation with litellm aimage_generation using a mocked OpenAI client
test xinference image generation with response_format, n, and size parameters passed through litellm
mock the OpenAI client images.generate method using AsyncMock and patch to capture call arguments
capture kwargs from an async method call using a side_effect function with nonlocal variables
validate that the xinference prefix is stripped from the model name before calling the OpenAI client
